review_scope: Primary-source reading and pedagogical arithmetic; no model-training replication.

verified_locations.finding: The GPT-4-family experimental model series excludes the original public GPT-2, GPT-3 and GPT-3.5 models.
NLP/chess use GPT-4 students, reward modeling uses a 3.5-level student. Best methods differ across panels, and the y-axis ranges differ.
Weak teacher, weak-to-strong student, ground-truth-supervised strong reference; PGR is (student-weak)/(strong reference-weak).
Imitation saliency and pretraining leakage are disanalogies to supervising future superhuman systems.
22 binary NLP tasks, first-move chess prediction, pairwise ChatGPT reward-model accuracy. RL policy optimization is not studied.
Auxiliary-confidence-loss results are medians over 22 NLP tasks; gains vary by model pair and dataset.

Mixture of weak labels and hardened student predictions. Adaptive threshold balances the batch; alpha_max .75 largest/.5 otherwise, linear warmup over first20%. Balanced-class assumption does not transfer automatically to unbalanced data.
Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat teacher, Qwen3-4B-Base student, Claude Opus4.6 researchers. Independent sandboxes, shared forum/storage, remote PGR evaluation.
Human baseline PGR .23; nine AARs reach .97 after five days, roughly800 cumulative research hours. The primary-slide59 chart measures per-AAR cumulative hours.
Directed vs undirected starting directions; eleven method families classify research ideas. Source entropy figure uses bits, article worked examples use nats explicitly.
CCS+Self-Distill PGR chat/math/code=.97/.94/.47; EM Posterior=.78/.75/-.12. Hyperparameters can be tuned during transfer; method components cannot be added/removed.
EM-based production transfer to Sonnet4.0 produces +.5 point within noise floor; elicitation-failure explanation is the authors hypothesis.
Instance-dependent noise-channel likelihood combined with strong-model prior, tempered posterior targets, two EM refinement rounds.
Unlimited score submissions make the test set function as validation with OOD split; reported failure modes include shortcuts and repeated-selection bias.
The announcement explicitly says detected inappropriate entries were disqualified. Article does not attribute the entire final result to hacks.
